from typing import List
from stickler.structured_object_evaluator import StructuredModel, ComparableField
from stickler.comparators import LevenshteinComparator
from pydantic import Field

class LineItem\(StructuredModel\):
    model_config = {''extra'': ''allow''}
    product: str = ComparableField\(comparator=LevenshteinComparator\(\), threshold=0.8\)

class Invoice\(StructuredModel\):
    items: List[LineItem] = ComparableField\(comparator=LevenshteinComparator\(\)\)

# Create line item with extra fields
inv1 = Invoice\(items=[LineItem\(product=''Widget A''\)]\)

# Create inv2 with line items that have extra fields
line_item_with_extra = LineItem.model_validate\({''product'': ''Widget A'', ''hallucinated_field'': ''oops''}\)
inv2 = Invoice\(items=[line_item_with_extra]\)

print\(''Line item has extra:'', inv2.items[0].__pydantic_extra__\)

# Test if the bug prevents counting extra fields within list items
result = inv1.compare_with\(inv2, include_confusion_matrix=True\)
print\(''Confusion matrix overall FA:'', result.get\(''confusion_matrix'', {}\).get\(''overall'', {}\).get\(''fa''\)\)
print\(''Expected FA: 1 \(from the hallucinated_field within the line item\)''\)
")
